summary: ITER181.A.1 Dashboard Layout Optimization — 14/14 acceptance criteria PASS. Activation Foundation collapsed into a single full-width card (.atd-activation, display:block, grid-template-columns:none) with [data-testid='activation-meter'] as the HEADER (class='atd-activation__header') containing eyebrow 'SETUP WORKSPACE' + cyan progress bar + counter '2/5 completati', and [data-testid='activation-checklist'] (class='atd-activation__checklist') as the BODY. All 5 activation-step-{identity,blueprint,team,market,workspace} render; identity+market done (no CTA), blueprint+team+workspace pending (CTAs visible). Quick Actions rail: 5 [data-testid='recommended-action-*'] cards all at y=1894 (same row), height=64px and width=332px each (within 56–140 spec). Section y-order: Hero(122) < Activation(730) < Projects-Journey(1189) < Desk-2col(1377) < Live-Relationships(1649) < Quick-Actions(1865) — Quick Actions IS the last section. RelationshipLiveTimeline: .rl-timeline__title='Attività relazionali', .rl-timeline__eyebrow='CRM · Live', empty state='Nessuna attività registrata. Le attività di Lead, Prospect, Clienti e Design Journey appariranno qui.'. QuickActionsSection .atd-section__eyebrow='Quick Actions'. Functional: click recommended-action-register-lead opens NewRelationshipModal (verified via [data-testid*='new-relationship']); click activation-step-blueprint-cta no error (stays on /dashboard, smart-cta route silent). topbar-new-relationship-cta present (prospects=0 branch). No banned words on dashboard. Responsive 1024x800: QA cards wrap to 2 rows, activation card remains full-width (853/956), zero horizontal overflow.
action_items: (Pre-existing, out of scope) Seed it-IT i18n keys auth.login.*, auth.access.*, nav.editorial_copy_cms, nav.admin_languages, nav.blueprint_admin to silence console warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: AtelierDashboardPage.jsx is well-organized: ActivationFoundationSection wraps a single .atd-activation card with both ActivationMeter (header) and WorkspaceActivationChecklist (body) as siblings — no nested 2-col grid. JSX order matches spec (Hero → Activation → Projects → Desk-2col → Live-Relationships → QuickActionsSection).
RecommendedActions.jsx is now a compact 5-up rail with consistent icon + body (label+desc) + arrow markup; bounding box confirms height=64px on desktop and proper wrapping on tablet.

ActivationMeter.jsx 'compact' branch returns a badge that is not used on the dashboard (only the default header branch is mounted in ActivationFoundationSection). The compact variant appears dead code path on dashboard — consider removing if not used elsewhere or keep for future use.
InspirationColumn is set to null with `void InspirationColumn;` placeholder — minor lint smell but intentional ITER181.A removal marker.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed tenant (activation 2/5: identity+market done; blueprint+team+workspace pending).
